line: In a grey, rainy square one red umbrella opens, and a waltz paints the whole plaza in colour.
line_cn: 灰色雨中广场，第一把红伞撑开，圆舞曲把整个广场刷上颜色。

transitions: Transitions: paint-over sweeps and scrapes, hard cuts on beats;
no dissolves (two layers of knife ridges turn to mud).
labels: Titles are laid in with the knife (a stroke-by-stroke appear sweep of about a second) and can be taken off by the world (washed by rain, scraped, painted over). They move with the world.
Small text (credits, data, captions) stays crisp DOM text over the painting: knife strokes can't carry small letters.
A serif display face (e.g. Cormorant, OFL). Subtitles, if there is a voice: plain serif, ≤ 2 lines, in a calm plane; hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
motion: Static paint is static. Only the things the story moves move (weather, figures, props, ribbons, light). Smooth 24 fps, no stepping: clarity is the brief.
Moving figures are procedural strokes rebuilt each frame from fixed seeds, so their paint doesn't boil (walk cycles, IK arms, props that open and close).
Actions sit on the music grid: a change of direction, a pop, a swell lands on a beat.
Anticipation → action → follow-through on every gesture (lift before the strike, dip before the snap, swing after the stop).

native_moves.name: Colour re-laid by the knife
native_moves.does: Every stroke keeps a grey and a colour version; a reveal wave re-paints them stroke by stroke (reveal, revC).
native_moves.fits: a town waking up; a patient recovering; a brand relaunch; a season turning.

native_moves.name: The one coloured thing
native_moves.does: The world drawn with grey: 1, one object with grey: 0.
native_moves.fits: one person in a crowd; the fruit that ripened; a warning light.

native_moves.name: Motion paints the picture
native_moves.does: Moving objects drip their colour as knife dabs; seen from above, their paths leave a painted pattern.
native_moves.fits: a dance; delivery routes across a city; a football play; migration.

native_moves.name: Raking light
native_moves.does: At the peak, drop the light to a grazing angle so every ridge catches it, then let it settle.
native_moves.fits: a sunrise; a moment of recognition; unveiling a sculpture.

native_moves.name: Paint-over transition
native_moves.does: The next shot's strokes are laid over the previous one in a sweep (appear), with a scrape on the soundtrack.
native_moves.fits: a renovation; memory replacing the present; a timeline of versions.

native_moves.name: Sound made visible
native_moves.does: A note or a voice becomes a paint ribbon that carries colour to what it touches.
native_moves.fits: a song reaching listeners; a radio broadcast; a rumour spreading.

score.note: acoustic with hand-made grain: solo strings, accordion, harp arpeggios
